name: Escalation Matter
description: A specific issue raised through the escalation process for decision at a defined authority level (02-data-model.md §8.2). The field set is the source template appendix, verbatim and therefore authoritative.

fields.label: Escalation ID
fields.description: The quotable identifier. Assigned from the record's key on first save.

fields.label: Escalation Type
fields.description: Drives the template and, with severity, the required-field set.

fields.label: Escalation Template
fields.description: Resolved from the type on validate; overridable.

fields.label: Identification Date
fields.description: When the matter was identified. Distinct from the escalation date below.

fields.label: Escalation Date
fields.description: When it was escalated. A separate field, per the template appendix.

fields.label: Severity Source
fields.description: [Inferred — §11.] Manual Override keeps a person's severity; Matrix lets the matrix resolve it.

fields.label: Matched Matrix Rule
fields.description: The rule code that fired, stored like the classification trace.

fields.label: Sensitive
fields.description: E-16 restricted visibility. A sensitive matter is excluded from list, search, report and API reads for users without the Sensitive Escalation Access role.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Open
In Progress
Under Review
Pending Review
Closed
Closed — Tracked Externally
fields.description: A label. Business logic reads the semantic flags, never this string.

fields.label: Workflow State
fields.description: Set by the framework's workflow engine where one is configured. Flags are derived from it as well as from status.

fields.label: Is Editable
fields.description: Semantic flag set from Workflow State Flag on validate. Business logic reads this, never the status label (02-data-model.md M-4).

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Semantic flag set from Workflow State Flag on validate. Business logic reads this, never the status label (02-data-model.md M-4).

fields.label: Is Open
fields.description: Semantic flag set from Workflow State Flag on validate. Business logic reads this, never the status label (02-data-model.md M-4).

fields.label: Requires Review
fields.description: Semantic flag set from Workflow State Flag on validate. Business logic reads this, never the status label (02-data-model.md M-4).

fields.label: Is Committable
fields.description: Semantic flag set from Workflow State Flag on validate. Business logic reads this, never the status label (02-data-model.md M-4).

fields.label: Requires Statement
fields.description: Semantic flag set from Workflow State Flag on validate. Business logic reads this, never the status label (02-data-model.md M-4).

fields.label: External Reference
fields.description: The issue-management record where closure is tracked outside the platform.

fields.label: Response Template Completed
fields.description: E-9 makes this mandatory for every escalation, including externally-tracked ones.

fields.label: SLA Definition
fields.description: [Inferred] The time threshold the matched matrix rule imposed.

fields.label: SLA Clock
fields.description: [Inferred] Core's clock for this matter. The module writes no timing logic of its own.

fields.label: Threshold Breached
fields.description: [Inferred — E17-S4 requires the breach to be recorded.]

fields.label: Auto Escalated
fields.description: [Inferred] Set when a breach raised the matter without a person acting.
